nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address holding contract ownership rights
BasicToken.balances: mapping(address => uint256) of multi-token balances
BasicToken.totalSupply_: total supply of the multi token
BasicMultiToken.tokens: array of underlying ERC20 tokens
ERC1003Token.sendersStack_: stack of msg.sender values used by approveAndCall
ERC1003Token.caller_: ERC1003Caller helper contract used to make arbitrary calls
MultiToken.inLendingMode: counter used as lending-mode lock
MultiToken.minimalWeight: minimum token weight used in price math
Ownable constructor: sets owner to msg.sender
renounceOwnership(): owner sets owner to address(0)
ERC1003Caller.makeCall(address,bytes): onlyOwner low-level call with value
ERC1003Token.transferFrom: substitutes caller_ with sendersStack_ top
BasicMultiToken.bundleFirstTokens: initial bundle when supply is zero
BasicMultiToken.bundle: computes proportional token amounts and calls _bundle
BasicMultiToken.unbundle: delegates to unbundleSome with all tokens
BasicMultiToken.unbundleSome: burns multi-tokens and transfers out inner tokens
BasicMultiToken._bundle: pulls inner tokens then mints multi-tokens
BasicMultiToken.lend: instant loan, transfers token out then arbitrary call
MultiToken.init: sets tokens, weights and minimalWeight
MultiToken.getReturn: quote computation using weights and balances
MultiToken.change: swaps tokens, updates no state, external transfers
FeeMultiToken.getReturn: applies changeFee on top of super.getReturn
changeWithRef: performs super.change and pays referral fee
FeeMultiToken.lend: enforces lend fee then calls super.lend
MultiTokenDeployer.deploy(bytes): onlyOwner deploys FeeMultiToken and calls init

Unsafe operation: sendersStack_.push(msg.sender) and unchecked sendersStack_.length -= 1
